title: Binance Futures Copy Trading Adjusts Leverage Limits for Lead Trader Portfolios (2025-01-17)
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Futures Copy Trading will adjust the  leverage limits for lead trader public portfolios .  Effective from  2025-01-17 00:00 UTC , the leverage for lead trader public portfolios will be limited to 10x when their respective portfolios’ AUM (Assets Under Management) of its active copy traders exceed  400,000 USDT . Lead traders with a copy traders’ AUM less than 400,000 USDT  will not  be impacted.   After Adjustment Before Adjustment Tigger Condition AUM of copy traders ≥ 400,000 USDT AUM ≥ 100,000 USDT Leverage Limits Up to 10x Up to 5x Start Futures Copy Trading Now! About Binance Futures Copy Trading Futures Copy Trading  allows users to copy experienced traders’ portfolios in real time. After determining the investment amount, the system will automatically copy trades from the lead traders’ portfolios that users select. Novice traders may familiarize themselves with the crypto market via Copy Trading, and build up their strategizing and trading techniques.
